legacy_gas_statistics.title: Old long-term statistics for {name}
legacy_gas_statistics.description:
Home Assistant still holds long-term statistics for `{entity_id}` and may warn that the entity "no longer has a state class". GloBird removed the state class on purpose: gas meters are read about every three months, so the entity cannot produce correct hourly usage.

Gas usage is now imported into the external statistic `{statistic_id}`, named *{name}*. In **Settings > Dashboards > Energy**, make sure the gas source is `{statistic_id}`, not `{entity_id}`.

If you no longer need the old `{entity_id}` statistics, you can delete them in **Developer tools > Statistics**. Deleting them does not affect `{statistic_id}`. This issue clears after the old statistics are deleted and Home Assistant restarts or the integration reloads.
